body:
TF2Tools now comes in German, French, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Simplified Chinese and Russian (preview), installs maps straight from GameBanana, and lets a profile hold your whole setup. It also brings a first preview of the Demo Viewer, which flies you around a demo's map in 3D, and our first outside contribution: thanks @mrampazz for the HUD card fix!

## What's Changed

<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at v6.2.0 -->

### New features
* Install, update and remove GameBanana maps from the Maps page by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1253
* Pick the app's language in Settings, with Russian as a preview by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1273
* Show error and success messages in the player's language by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1285
* Dates, times, counts and sizes follow your language by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1289
* Bug details stay in English, and the last messages follow your language by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1291
* The library pages follow your language by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1293
* The stores follow your language by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1296
* The logs pages and the app's header follow your language by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1300
* TF2Tools starts in your system's language until you pick one by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1305
* The HUD Maker and the Crosshair Maker follow your language by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1308
* The HUD Maker names a HUD's parts in your language by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1310
* TF2Tools in Brazilian Portuguese by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1311
* TF2Tools in Spanish by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1321
* TF2Tools in German by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1323
* TF2Tools in French by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1325
* TF2Tools in Simplified Chinese by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1329
* Profiles moves to the bottom of the sidebar's Tools group by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1339
* Remove TF2Tools 4 reliably from the banner on Windows by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1341
* Our own pictures of every graphics setting by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1342
* Search the Crosshair Store by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1364
* Profiles hold your whole setup by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1369
* Download a log's demo from demos.tf by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1398
* Fly around a demo's map in 3D (Demo Viewer preview) by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1401
* See the players in the Demo Viewer as RED and BLU boxes by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1423
* The Graphics page shows pictures for the Player model setting by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1429
* Demo Viewer downloads a missing map for you by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1436
* Groundwork for browsing demos.tf by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1443
### Fixes
* Show world and player kills on logs.tf as Environment and Enemy suicide by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1254
* Tests that HUD imports and add-on installs never race the library compression by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1280
* The Maps GameBanana tab scrolls in a small window by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1301
* Sound cards keep their Hit and Kill buttons inside the card in a small window by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1302
* Error lines change language along with the rest of the app by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1303
* Messages that stay on screen change language with the rest of the app by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1307
* The HUD Maker's panels no longer cover its toolbar in a small window by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1316
* The last English labels now follow your language by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1318
* Sound names and the HUD Maker start card fit in a small window by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1320
* Long tooltips fit the window, and a re-saved crosshair goes straight into TF2 by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1324
* Percentages, the Escape key and the empty logs.tf cache read right in every language by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1327
* Large percentages group their digits like other numbers by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1331
* Lists use the Chinese enumeration comma in Chinese by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1333
* HUD Store details name systems properly and use each language's colon by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1334
* Keep the Graphics page still when you pick a picture by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1361
* Show a spinner while a sound preview downloads by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1366
* Graphics page: settings mastercomfig dropped can now be cleared from the changes strip by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1372
* Re-download a missing Addon Store add-on when you apply a profile by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1373
* Uninstalling a GameBanana add-on keeps it in your library by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1374
* Graphics page: a choice that matches the new preset keeps its Reset by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1375
* Graphics page: the list no longer jumps on the first change by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1376
* Graphics page: the settings search follows a language switch by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1377
* Graphics page: open pictures close when search or "Changed only" hides their row by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1378
* Graphics page: zoomed compare no longer puts a crop next to a full picture by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1379
* Fit translated logs.tf column titles in their columns by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1424
* Fix the pilot harness build after the Linux pointer lock by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1434
* Older demos from demos.tf download again by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1439
### Usability and accessibility
* Name GameBanana on the Sound Store and hud-db on the Curated HUD tab by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1255
* Notice a map folder deleted outside the app when you come back to Maps by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1257
* Keep long names whole in the store details window by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1258
* Settings is shorter and shows where your disk space goes by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1299
* A clearer Graphics page that shows what you changed by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1343

* Graphics: hide the zoom toggle when only one picture has a close-up by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1388

* Profiles: the editor's changes strip stacks by its own width by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1396

* Graphics: match the agreed mock by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1400
* The Profiles editor's compare pill now says "This profile" by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1412
* Centre the logs.tf column titles and sort arrows by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1421
* Graphics keeps the category list beside the settings when the sidebar is collapsed by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1425
* Screen readers call the profile's side of the picture compare "this profile" by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1426
* Keep turning the demo view when a drag leaves it, and hold the cursor on Windows by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1427
* Profiles editor rows fit the panel they sit in by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1428
* Hold the cursor while dragging to look in the Demo Viewer on Linux by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1431
* Demo Viewer fills the page, with controls you can move and minimise by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1435
* Demo Viewer: set how fast the camera turns by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1441
### Performance
* Smooth scrolling through the licence notices in Settings by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1261
* Clear full logs.tf logs you haven't opened, keep their stats by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1274
* Keep HUDs and GameBanana add-ons compressed in the library by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1276
* Keep crosshairs compressed in the library too by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1278
* Graphics page: settings rows are built once per change, not on every frame by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1381
* Profiles: build the editor's setting rows once per change by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1393
### Other changes
* Show the Crosshair Store search in the README by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1365
* HUD cards with a picture no longer hide the Install button by @mrampazz in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1444
* Say in the contributing guide that outside changes are welcome by @PhongGuy in https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/pull/1447

## Downloads

| Platform | File |
| --- | --- |
| Windows x64 | [TF2Tools.exe](https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/releases/download/v6.2.0/TF2Tools.exe) |
| Linux x86_64 | [tf2tools_6.2.0_x86_64.AppImage](https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/releases/download/v6.2.0/tf2tools_6.2.0_x86_64.AppImage) for most Linux systems, or [tf2tools_6.2.0_amd64.deb](https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/releases/download/v6.2.0/tf2tools_6.2.0_amd64.deb) for Ubuntu and Debian |

Each file also has a copy with no version in its name, for links that always point at the latest release. Check a download with `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS`. To check that a file was built by GitHub from this project's own code, use `gh attestation verify <file> --repo PhongGuy/TF2Tools`.

## Before you install

- **Windows:** Windows may show a blue box saying "Windows protected your PC". TF2Tools is free and not signed with a paid certificate, so Windows does not recognise it yet. Click "More info", then "Run anyway". Only do this for the file from this page. TF2Tools 6 installs next to TF2Tools 4. Once it works, you can remove TF2Tools 4 in Windows Settings > Apps.
- **Linux AppImage:** after downloading, right-click the file, open Properties, allow it to run as a program, then double-click it.
- **Linux .deb:** open it with your software installer and click Install.

## Updates

On Windows and with the AppImage, TF2Tools checks for new versions and installs them itself after checking their signature. The .deb does not update itself; get new versions from the [Releases page](https://github.com/PhongGuy/TF2Tools/releases).
